text:
olivia (People Ops): hi @john.doe — quick preboarding checklist for your Day 1 next Monday :wave:
- confirm I-9 method (remote vs kiosk)
- bg check intake (VeriCheck) status
- benefits access + W-4 completed
- laptop + VPN arrival window

john.doe: hey! thanks. i set my start date. quick q — VeriCheck asked for a payment method? i wasn't expecting that. also i keep getting an upload error for my passport pic.

elaine (People Ops): @john.doe we do NOT charge candidates. VeriCheck sometimes shows a $1 authorization for ID verification if you choose mobile ID capture; it should clear. if you prefer no auth, select "Upload manually" in the VeriCheck portal.

elaine (People Ops): For the passport upload error — try the mobile app (Chrome on phone) and make sure permissions allowed. If it still fails, ping us and we can schedule an in-person kiosk so we can complete I-9 on Day 1.

john.doe: ok switching to manual upload now. if that fails, i'll take the kiosk. what's the kiosk location and window?

olivia (People Ops): k kiosk details below — we prefer remote I-9 but kiosks available by appointment.
```
Kiosk: Redwood HQ - 3rd floor visitor desk, 345 Market St, Suite 300
Available slots: Mon-Fri 9:00-11:30 & 13:00-16:00
Check-in code: REDW-ONB-789
Bring: passport OR (DL + SSN card). ID must be original.
```

raj (IT): @john.doe once you confirm, i'll ship a laptop express. ETA 2 business days. to confirm VPN access pre-Day1, can you run this quick check and paste the output?
```
curl -s https://welcome.redwood.ai/health | jq .status
```

john.doe: ran it — got back {"status":"ok"} 👍 looks good.

vericheck-bot: VeriCheck update — background check portal sent to john.doe at john.doe@example.com. Status: link delivered. If you don't receive the email, check spam or request resend with `resend_vericheck_link` and tag people-ops.

sarah (Onboarding Buddy): hey @john.doe i'm your buddy — welcome! i'll do a 30-min intro call Day 1 at 10:00 PT. i'll send calendar invite. feel free to ask any day-1 logistics Qs here. :smile: 

elaine (People Ops): benefits reminder — please complete W-4 + AtlasBenefits enrollment before EOD Friday to avoid payroll delay. Portal link was in your offer email; subject line: "Action required: Redwood Benefits & Tax Forms". If you need the link again reply here and i'll re-send.

john.doe: appreciate it. sent a screenshot of the passport upload error to this thread. if manual upload works now i'll mark done.

olivia (People Ops): got it — if manual upload succeeds, we mark I-9 as Remote Verified. otherwise book a kiosk slot w/ check-in code above and reply with your chosen time. we'll confirm laptop shipping and calendar invites after I-9 is verified. :thumbsup:

raj (IT): noted for laptop. john, once you pick a kiosk slot or confirm remote, i'll create IT ticket #IT-2417 and cc you.

john.doe: manual upload worked! portal shows "ID received". thanks everyone. excited to start.

olivia (People Ops): awesome — marked as remote I-9 complete. next: finish W-4 + AtlasBenefits by Friday. sarah will send Day 1 agenda. welcome aboard :tada:
